commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+4' The resulting corner from Florent Mollet (Nantes) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.

90+4' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. The ball is out of play. Nantes will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+4' Moses Simon (Nantes) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Nantes will take a corner kick.

90+1' Matthis Abline (Nantes) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Kevin Van Den Kerkhof leaves the pitch and is replaced by Joseph Nduquidi (Metz).
89' Florent Mollet (Nantes) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
88' A lofted cross from Benie Traore (Nantes) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Now Nantes have a corner.
86' A tremendous drive by Lamine Camara (Metz) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Alban Lafont makes a brilliant save.
85' Florent Mollet (Nantes) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
84' Moses Simon (Nantes) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
83' Laszlo Boloni has decided to substitute Arthur Atta and he is replaced by Sadibou Sane (Metz).
81' Great teamplay by Nantes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Matthis Abline (Nantes) for Douglas Augusto.
79' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) rises above the defenders and places a towering header low towards the middle of the goal, but Alexandre Oukidja is prepared and thwarts him.
78' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja comes off his line to gather the ball.
77' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
75' Florent Mollet (Nantes) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
73' Arthur Atta (Metz) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
70' Florent Mollet (Nantes) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
68' The foul by Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Eric Wattellier.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) comes onto the pitch for Marcus Coco.
64' Eric Wattellier shows the yellow card to Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) for a heavy challenge.
63' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) sees a yellow card from Eric Wattellier after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
61' Lamine Camara (Metz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
60' 0 - 2 Goal! Georges Mikautadze is the provider and Matthieu Udol (Metz) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the bottom left corner from close in with his head. 0:2.
59' Here is a change. Pedro Chirivella is going off and Jocelyn Gourvennec gives the last tactical orders to Benie Traore (Nantes).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mostafa Mohamed departs the field of play to be replaced by Tino Kadewere (Nantes).
58' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Georges Mikautadze (Metz) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Alban Lafont no chance!
58' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
57' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Metz! Let's see who will take responsibility.
56' The ball is out of play. Metz win a corner kick.
56' Lamine Camara (Metz) takes the corner which is cleared. The ball is out of play. Metz win a corner kick.

55' Matthieu Udol (Metz) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Metz.
54' Metz force their opponents to concede a corner.
54' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. Metz force their opponents to concede a corner.
52' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) latches onto a short pass from Maxime Colin inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
51' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
48' Matthieu Udol (Metz) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is out of play. Nantes will take a throw-in.
46' Moses Simon (Nantes) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) commits a rough foul. Eric Wattellier stops the game and makes a call.
41' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) is penalised for a foul. Eric Wattellier had a clear view and blows his whistle.
39' A pass by Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
37' The corner from Florent Mollet (Nantes) is cleared away by the defence.
36' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
35' Marcus Coco (Nantes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
33' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
30' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
28' Today's referee Eric Wattellier rightly decides to book Maxime Colin (Metz) for his harsh tackle.
25' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
23' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) gathers a cross inside the box and strikes the ball. He wastes a great scoring opportunity as his shot only hits the right-hand post.
21' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Florent Mollet (Nantes), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
21' Florent Mollet (Nantes) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. It will be a corner kick for Nantes.
19' Matthieu Udol (Metz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
17' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
17' Florent Mollet (Nantes) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
16' Christophe Herelle (Metz) is penalised for holding. Eric Wattellier signals a set piece. It's a free kick to Nantes in a dangerous position.
15' Moses Simon (Nantes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
12' Florent Mollet (Nantes) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
11' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
9' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

6' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
2' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Fali Cande (Metz), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nantes will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Eric Wattellier.
